gen-dafont-bloody-gf-atkinson-hyperlegib: Bloody is the loud one, with big round lowercase bowls. Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono does the quieter job, with open counters breathing into white space and capitals that feel clipped beside the lowercase.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-chivo: Chivo's lowercase sits packed up toward the capitals, with visible daylight showing through every one of its curved openings. Bloody's big round bowls take the lead while Chivo holds steady underneath.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-chocolate-classical: Commanding up top, thanks to Bloody's big round lowercase bowls. What lifts the pair is Chocolate Classical Sans, with a sizable lowercase and a broad-nibbed pen stroke that never curls shut.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-cossette-texte: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls do all the shouting. Cossette Texte keeps a monoline stroke from start to finish and a prominent x-height, so long paragraphs should read smoothly.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-duru-sans: Commanding bowls in Bloody sit above Duru Sans, whose small letters have wide openings and bodies that dominate the line. Paragraphs in Duru Sans should read cleanly, ascenders barely showing.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-fresca: Fresca reads cleanly, with no calligraphic thinning and apertures that keep its counters connected to the outside space. Bloody is made to command; Fresca is made to be read.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-mysuru: Hind Mysuru keeps its lowercase tall, tops pressing close to ascender height. Bloody is best at commanding with big round bowls, Hind Mysuru at staying free of hairlines in small sizes.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-siliguri: Bloody's big round lowercase bowls grab attention first, loud and commanding against the quieter text around them. Hind Siliguri hums below at a constant line weight, approachable and flat.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-hind-vadodara: Hind Vadodara leaves spacious gaps at its rounded terminals. Bloody's big round lowercase bowls take the commanding role, while Hind Vadodara's tall-bowled e and a keep a clean, unswollen line.
gen-dafont-bloody-gf-huninn: Modern at heart, Huninn keeps its s terminals clear of the body. Under Bloody's commanding, big-bowled lowercase, Huninn's crossbars, as fat as their stems, keep the text grounded and sturdy.
